fields.description: Issue dated Saturday, April 2, 1927. Prominent editorials criticize City of Miami franchise contracts with Florida Power & Light, alleging hidden provisions affecting rates and warning of potential municipal financial harm; the paper urges legal and civic action to nullify or challenge the contracts. Coverage includes local politics and the upcoming city commission election (including references to Abe Aronovitz and Leroy Morgan), commentary on Governor John W. Martin and taxes, discussion of dividing Florida into two states, local news briefs and community events in Miami and Miami Beach, real-estate satire, and advertisements and legal notices including oil-lease promotions and a master’s sale notice.
